question: With which country does India share the longest border?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bangladesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bangladesh** 
 
• It shares the longest border with India.
 
• Bangladesh shares a **4,096-kilometre-long **(2,545 mi) international border with India.
 
• Bangladesh–India border is the **fifth-longest land border** in the world.
 
• Five Indian states that share their border with Bangladesh:
 
 
• Assam.
 
• Tripura.
 
• Mizoram.
 
• Meghalaya.
 
• West Bengal.
